text.tspan: A deployable command-line application that validates, renders, and
manages Aurora models. The CLI is optimized for deterministic,
automatable workflows (local scripting and CI), and delegates model
semantics (parsing, invariants, rendering) to the shared library.
A deployable application that provides an interactive experience for
creating, editing, and navigating Aurora models. The Editor focuses on
discoverability and safe, incremental iteration with immediate
A VS Code extension that enables authoring, validation, and
visualization of Aurora models within the editor. It provides
trust-aware workspace integration, webview-based UI experiences, and
(optionally) an MCP server surface for other in-editor tooling.
Shared library component used across tooling surfaces to load, validate,
update, and save Aurora models. It is the implementation home for common
parsing, invariants, deterministic rendering, and safe write semantics.
The Tauri/Svelte front-end UI component for the Editor application.
The Rust backend component for the Editor application, hosting the
Editor UI component that presents an explorer tree over the Aurora
Editor UI component that provides a mind-map-like visualization
Editor UI component for editing cards, attributes, and links in an
Editor UI component for viewing and editing human-readable Markdown

extension to expose Aurora model operations via the shared library.

Aurora model domain component representing a directed graph of cards and
Aurora card domain component representing a single architectural

rendering, and compact export for Aurora models.

Component that mediates workspace file operations (open, watch, and
